test_title: PYST 4: SSC CGL 2022 - English (Held On: 01 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The monster trucks have very _______ engines, they can probably pull a train coach without any problem.
solution:
The correct answer is option 4), i.e., 'powerful.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__ 

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the words given in the options:

 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 dominant
 liking to take control in a group and having natural authority. (एक समूह में नियंत्रण रखना और प्राकृतिक अधिकार रखना पसंद करना)
 
 

 forceful
 expressing opinions strongly and demanding attention or action. (दृढ़ता से राय व्यक्त करना और ध्यान या कार्रवाई की मांग करना)
 
 

 impressive
 If an object or achievement is impressive, you admire or respect it, usually because it is special, important, or very large. (यदि कोई वस्तु या उपलब्धि प्रभावशाली है, तो आप उसकी प्रशंसा या सम्मान करते हैं, आमतौर पर क्योंकि यह विशेष, महत्वपूर्ण या बहुत बड़ी है)
 
 

 powerful
 having a lot of strength or force. (बहुत अधिक शक्ति या बल होना)
 
 
 
 

 
• The context of the sentence is that the engines of the monster trucks have enormous strength that they can easily pull a train coach.
 
• According to the above-mentioned points, the most appropriate word to fill in the blank is "powerful."
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 4.

 
• Another example:

 
 
• *You need a **powerful **saw to cut through metal.*
 
 

 

Complete Sentence:__* The monster trucks have very __**powerful**__ engines, they can probably pull a train coach without any problem.*
